title: Codebook reconciler for two coders

provenance.origin: Written for the AstaUI prototype; not a real participant's work.

notes: Forty invented excerpts from dementia caregiver interviews (P01 to P08), each coded once by coder A and once by coder B with a single code from a seven-code codebook; twelve disagree. Cohen's kappa is computed in the page, overall across all seven codes and per code as present or absent. The kappas describe the independent coding and do not change as disagreements are resolved. Resolutions, notes and edited definitions are kept in localStorage.
